studies.name: Tiberian pronunciation · Genesis 1:1–13
studies.sourceTitle: Geoffrey Khan, The Tiberian Pronunciation Tradition of Biblical Hebrew, Volume I (2020), §I.5.4.1, pp. 614–618
studies.coverageStatus: Publication identifies passage. No source-edition comparison or word/syllable/audio alignment is supplied by this app. Opening the text displays unchanged UXLC.
studies.description: A scholarly reconstruction of Tiberian pronunciation, performed by Alex Foreman in two dagesh readings and with or without a source-labeled Sefardi melody. These are fixed performances, with their original pronunciation, pitch and timing.
studies.limits: This study is separate from the six historical Kinnor Accent labels and from a complete communal melody grammar. The recordings do not provide independently controllable singing synthesis.
